seo_title: Achala Swarm — Overview | Achala IT Solutions
meta_description: Hundreds of agents as one governed, measurable workforce.

blocks.x: Hundreds of agents as one governed, measurable workforce. Achala Swarm is the platform layer behind it — deployed under NDA, documented for the audit.

Achala Swarm is the orchestration layer for agentic operations: role definitions, task queues and bidding, durable execution with saga compensation, policy envelopes (solo/approval/forbidden), per-team budgets, kill switches, and a control tower for fleet health, throughput and cost per completed task. Swarm treats agents as workforce, not scripts: onboarding with role specs, SLAs and budget; release management with shadow and canary cohorts; incident response with rollback. It runs our agentic process automation, digital workforce and workflow orchestration services under one accountable control plane.

roles, bidding, priority lanes, SLA routing

blocks.title: Achala Swarm — module topology
blocks.note: Modules are the platform's named components; trust lane is what the audit reads.

blocks.x: Every agent action is policy-checked and logged under immutable audit trails. Tool access is scoped per role with short-lived credentials; high-risk actions require approval workflows. Swarm's evidence pack maps to ISO 42001 and NIST AI RMF expectations for agentic systems.
Where you would find it working

Achala Swarm runs under NDA in Banking & Financial Services, Insurance & Risk, Telecom, Media & Entertainment, Logistics & Supply Chain, Public Sector & Government. Deployments stay private; the architecture and control packs are the part we can show.
Connects to: Temporal, LangGraph, Kafka, OPA, Kubernetes, core/SaaS connectors. Adapters are versioned and contract-tested, so upgrades stop being incidents.

Swarm runs agent fleets on generative knowledge-workflow blueprints. A planner compiles the work into an orchestration blueprint; a temporal reasoning module sequences the time-sensitive steps; a knowledge-liquidity protocol layer lets workflows reconfigure and share structure across teams without hard-coded pipelines. Execution is decentralized with validation at every handoff. A multi-objective evolutionary algorithm tunes execution parameters, and policy-gradient multi-agent reinforcement learning assigns shared-reward credit across the fleet — so the system learns which agent did what, and one node cannot game the payoff.

items: Work is compiled to blueprints, not scripted — the fleet re-plans when the process changes.
Deadlines, windows and sequencing are first-class constraints in the plan.
Workflow structure moves between teams without hard-coded pipelines.
Execution parameters are refined against cost, quality and throughput together.
Policy-gradient multi-agent RL keeps incentives aligned across the fleet.
